findings.title: Reason tables in the command docs are left out of the brief
findings.detail: docs/src/commands/run.md:470-477 and docs/src/commands/impacted-tests.md:35-40 each have a table with one row per `run_all` reason (`tyf_unavailable`, `fast_suite`, …). The brief's Docs section only names triage.md, ADR 0025, the ADR README and ADR 0024, so `unborn_head` would be missing from both tables. Add a row to each. The R3 text change should also be checked against docs/src/commands/changed-symbols.md:106 (the root-commit note), and an unborn-HEAD line added there for A8.

findings.title: The real-pytest QA check doesn't say how pytest is resolved
findings.detail: 'R1: real pytest (A1)' says 'with uv/pytest available', but pytest is not on PATH on this machine. GERENUK_PYTEST takes a single binary. What works: `[tool.gerenuk] pytest-command = ["uvx", "pytest"]`. In a repo with commits, `gerenuk run --base HEAD -- -q` with that key printed `1 passed`. State this setup in the check, or the dev will hit `pytest not found` and may report cannot_run.

findings.title: Fallback QA check should spell out the JSON-array form
findings.detail: `--fallback-command` and `fallback-command` take a JSON array of strings. A bare path fails with `must be a JSON array of strings` (exit 2) before the unborn check is reached. The A3 check should show `--fallback-command '["/path/fb.sh"]'`, so it tests the unborn path and not argument parsing.

findings.title: Code references verified
findings.detail: All references match today's code: src/cli.rs:467 `resolve_base` returns `Result<Base>`; `impacted_run` has a `Diff::WorkingTree` arm at :597 that calls `resolve_base` and then `git.untracked()`; `Git::try_run` is public and `output` private; `resolve_last_commit` falls back to `resolve_base(None)`; `Reason::ALL` is `[Self; 10]`; `impact::run_all` takes `ChangedSymbols`; `Payload::new` already takes `Option<&ChangedSymbols>`; the hook fixture is `Hooked` at tests/run.rs:1225; ADR 0024:11 has the root-commit note; triage.md is 60 lines and ends with `next: run`; the latest ADR is 0024, so 0025 is free. No existing test pins the chain message text, so the R3 change won't break A11. git 2.56 supports `worktree add --orphan`. Nothing in the brief is already built. It fits the pitch, the no-gos and the decisions, and one session.
